newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total sees 35 pct rise in H1 oper result.
newsitem.headline: Total sees 35 pct rise in H1 oper result.

text.p: French oil group Total SA expects its operating result to improve by 35 percent in the first half of 1997 versus the same period last year, Total chairman Thierry Demarest told his group's annual shareholders meeting.
"Given these elements, Total's operating result should rise by 35 percent in the first half of 1997 versus the first half of 1996," he said, referring to several elements.
Total's operating profit for the first half of 1996 was 4.96 billion francs.

The elements he referred to included a "climate which can generally be described as satisfactory", growth in upstream activities outside the Middle East, with a backdrop of a strong dollar rise and a fairly robust oil price.
Dowstream, Demarest said "we have continued to see volatile European refining margins but they are markedly above their level of a year ago".
External growth was helping on the chemicals side, as was a rise in the dollar and sterling. frs/bfl
